decision.summary: A multi-axis displacement initiates near index 630: E jumps up and sustains a plateau until ~640; U jumps up then descends gradually, accelerating after ~640. No complete opposing return is observed for either axis within allowed context [590,670]. The E offset ends near 640, but the U descent continues beyond without rejoining pre-event baseline. N shows only a smooth decline, no step. Thus, two overlapping uncertain temporary-offset intervals are identified based on onset, interior behavior, and incomplete return.

intervals.observation: E: abrupt upward jump at ~630–632 (+~10 MAD), sustained elevated platform until ~640; U: concurrent upward jump (+~8 MAD) followed by slower descent starting ~635, not fully returned by 640; N: gradual decline during same interval, no sharp edge. Return in E is absent before 640; U shows partial descent but no clear opposing return to pre-jump level within allowed context.

U: sharp downward drop beginning ~640, continuing through 642 (~−10 MAD total from peak at 630), overlapping with end of E platform. No matching upward return observed; E remains elevated until ~640 then begins declining after 640. Interior sustained offset in E (630–640) and U (630–642) lacks full closure; return phase incomplete/unobserved within allowed context.
